purpose: Integration contract for the editor Library and Inspiration surfaces. Stable catalog IDs are preserved verbatim.

rendererEvidence.mappingRule: rendererForm is the currently supported generic procedural form, not a species-accurate model or an assurance that a purchased material resembles the preview.

presentationPolicy.preview: Use an original in-app procedural swatch/viewport preview for catalog materials. Do not present it as supplier photography or a botanical/material scan.
presentationPolicy.originals: Fishy Original Blender previews belong only in the separate Originals/templates surface; do not reuse them as catalog-material previews.
presentationPolicy.sourceAttribution: Keep the named publisher and outbound source link on the details sheet; use concise provenance in browse cards.
presentationPolicy.pricingAndCompatibility: No price, stock, purchase, livestock compatibility, or tank-size compatibility fields are available in this registry.
